# 🚚 Migration Plan Template

## Current and target state
Versions, reason, scope and excluded behavior.

## Compatibility analysis
APIs, config, browser support, dependencies, build behavior, assets, tests and deployment impact.

## Phases
| Phase | Action | Owner | Validation | Rollback |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Data migration
Document source/target format, transformations, integrity and backup. Mark N/A with rationale when no data store exists.

## Risks and verification
Include clean install, tests, build, manual smoke, browser/accessibility checks, deployment and rollback rehearsal.

## Approval and communication
Owner, reviewers, release notes and support plan.
